articles.title: UK regulators to prepare tokenized gold framework: Report
articles.description: The UK’s FCA is reportedly preparing a regulatory framework for tokenized gold and how these products may be used as collateral assets in wholesale markets.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Bitcoin Red Team founder turns to Chinese AI: ‘It absolutely guts me’
articles.description: Bitcoin Red Team has now found 1,288 critical and high-level vulnerabilities in the Bitcoin ecosystem as of Saturday.

articles.title: Australia orders Cryptolink Bitcoin ATMs offline over ‘basic reporting’ failures
articles.description: Australia’s financial watchdog has suspended Cryptolink’s registration for three months, adding to a crackdown that previously saw the Bitcoin ATM operator fined $56,340.

articles.title: Crypto’s first quantum attack will look like unexplained breach: Quantus founder
articles.description: Bad actors with access to a cryptography-breaking quantum computer probably won’t try to announce it to the world by hacking Satoshi Nakamoto’s high-profile Bitcoin wallets, crypto executives say.

articles.title: BIP-110 ends with a whimper, CLARITY vote punted: Hodler’s Digest, Aug. 9
articles.description: BIP-110 forks itself into oblivion with a “2-block chain” and CLARITY will finally get a Senate vote in September. The odds say that vote will be a No.

articles.title: Ex-US defense secretary calls CLARITY Act a ‘national security bill’
articles.description: Former US Defense Secretary Mark Esper says the CLARITY Act is not merely a financial services bill, its a national security one.

articles.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
articles.description: The enforcing fork remains stuck at Bitcoin’s full mining difficulty as mandatory signaling proceeds with little hashpower support.

articles.title: Brazil targets crypto fraud with up to 24-hour transfer hold
articles.description: The rules, effective Jan. 1, 2027, cover transactions above $10,000 sent to overseas providers or self-custody wallets, along with other transfers flagged for review.

articles.title: BTCPay restricts remote Lightning access after attackers steal funds
articles.description: Foundation and Citadel21 reported drained Lightning nodes, but the total amount stolen and number of affected operators remain unknown.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s BIP-110 enters mandatory signaling with miner support below 3%
articles.description: The deployment milestone tests whether enforcing nodes can sustain the change amid limited miner signaling and discussion of a hard-fork fallback.

articles.title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs post best week since April with $1B inflows
articles.description: The spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds registered their third-strongest showing since October as institutional demand showed signs of renewed momentum.

articles.title: US Senate to vote on advancing CLARITY Act in September after Thune files cloture
articles.description: The procedural move puts crypto market structure legislation back on track as lawmakers continue negotiations over ethics and stablecoin provisions.

articles.title: Bitcoin will never fall below $60K again: Nansen founder
articles.description: Crypto is growing up thanks to trading in real world assets, and Bitcoin will never dip below $60K again, says Nansen founder founder Alex Svanevik.

articles.title: Domestic stablecoins could boost demand for dollar-backed tokens: IMF
articles.description: IMF first deputy managing director Dan Katz says users may favor digital dollars for their liquidity, network effects and cross-border acceptance.

articles.title: US court backs Bybit’s bid to trace funds from $1.5B North Korea hack
articles.description: Expedited discovery allows the exchange to seek account identities, balances and transaction histories from platforms with US operations.

articles.title: Donald Trump’s media company to terminate Crypto.com deal
articles.description: The president’s company will unwind an agreement with Crypto.com to create a multibillion-dollar CRO treasury and reportedly not integrate prediction markets onto Truth Social.

articles.title: US Treasury’s OFAC sanctions 2 Iran-linked crypto exchanges
articles.description: The US government sanctioned an individual and two crypto exchanges it said facilitated money laundering for a combined $5 million in digital assets linked to Iran.

articles.title: Circle expands USDC to OKX ecosystem with X Layer launch
articles.description: The rollout gives X Layer users access to Circle-issued USDC and crosschain transfers as the stablecoin expands across major blockchain ecosystems.

articles.title: Reform UK chair calls for probe into SBF-linked donation: Report
articles.description: As the chairman of the Reform UK calls for an investigation into a FTX-linked political donation, the party’s leader prepares to face voters amid his own crypto-related scandal.

articles.title: Bitcoin price tags $65.3K August high as low US jobs numbers cool Fed rate bets
articles.description: Bitcoin hit month-to-date highs above $65,000 as risk-assets gained on low US nonfarm payrolls data.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Crypto’s biggest business is starting to look a lot like banking
articles.description: Crypto business is converging with banking as stablecoin reserves, tokenized funds, Treasury income and balance sheet management become key profit drivers.

articles.title: Fierce backlash to Ethereum’s EIP-8363 staking proposal
articles.description: Ethereum’s proposed EIP-8363 staking overhaul aims to reduce issuance, but critics say it could hurt DeFi, decentralization and institutional adoption.

articles.title: Bitcoiners turn to dice throws as self-custody setups are re-evaluated
articles.description: Dice entropy may become the new gold standard after the Coldcard hack

articles.title: Russia cracks down on 9 crypto exchanges in Moscow City
articles.description: Russia has shut down nine unregistered crypto exchanges in Moscow, with the FSB alleging they helped move scam proceeds abroad through Ukrainian call centers.

articles.title: CEX perpetual futures volume falls to $4T, lowest since late 2023
articles.description: Perpetual futures trading volume on crypto exchanges fell to its lowest level in 31 months, while perpetual trading on decentralized platforms neared a one-year low.

articles.title: Binance Bitcoin volume ratio hits record as futures outweigh spot eight times over
articles.description: Binance saw a record divergence between daily spot and futures trading volumes, with the latter reaching nearly $58 billion.

articles.title: CleanSpark misses Wall Street revenue estimates as shares sink
articles.description: CleanSpark’s shares fell 5.5% on Thursday after the Bitcoin miner reported $138 million in quarterly revenue, narrowly missing Wall Street’s consensus estimate.

articles.title: Stripe-owned Bridge joins EU MiCA register after Luxembourg approval
articles.description: Stripe-owned Bridge has entered the EU MiCA register following Luxembourg approval, joining regulated providers under the bloc’s crypto framework.

articles.title: CLARITY Act delay gives Asian financial hubs an opening: First Digital CEO
articles.description: Industry figures warned that continued legislative limbo could slow institutional adoption, revive regulation by enforcement and push innovation offshore.
